# Design 4.2 row 31 under Bzlmod: rules_req_compile, a hand-written
# `http_jar` pin, and a hub of a module that is not the root (the root
# imports a repository from an extension it gives no tag).

=== .bazelversion
9.3.2
=== MODULE.bazel
module(name = "app")

bazel_dep(name = "rules_req_compile", version = "1.7.1")
bazel_dep(name = "rules_python", version = "1.4.1")

requirements = use_extension("@rules_req_compile//extensions:python.bzl", "requirements")
requirements.parse(
    name = "req_compile_deps",
    requirements_locks = {
        "//3rdparty:requirements.linux_x86_64.txt": "linux_x86_64",
        "//3rdparty:requirements.macos_aarch64.txt": "macos_aarch64",
    },
)
use_repo(requirements, "req_compile_deps")

pip = use_extension("@rules_python//python/extensions:pip.bzl", "pip")
use_repo(pip, "their_pip")

http_jar = use_repo_rule("@bazel_tools//tools/build_defs/repo:http.bzl", "http_jar")

http_jar(
    name = "guava",
    url = "https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/com/google/guava/guava/33.0.0-jre/guava-33.0.0-jre.jar",
)
=== 3rdparty/requirements.linux_x86_64.txt
six==1.16.0
=== 3rdparty/requirements.macos_aarch64.txt
six==1.16.0
=== 3rdparty/BUILD.bazel
